events.title: Agent Pay launched with Mastercard Agentic Tokens
events.detail: Collaborators Microsoft, IBM, Braintree and Checkout.com.

events.title: Developers Agent Toolkit repository created
events.detail: Documentation MCP server; no payments.

events.title: US enablement plan: Citi and U.S. Bank first
PayOS claims first live payment with a Mastercard Agentic Token
Agent Pay Acceptance Framework introduced
events.detail: A Mastercard story by Pablo Fourez says the framework is shared on Mastercard Developers for feedback.

events.title: Developer documentation live as an early preview
Cloudflare describes edge verification for Agent Pay and Visa TAP
PayPal wallet integration and Acceptance Framework pilot
First agentic transaction on the network reported on the Q3 call
events.detail: Mastercard's CEO also said U.S. Bank and Citi cardholders could now use Agent Pay and that the rest of its US issuers would be enabled in November 2025. On the next call, on 2026-01-29, he said US issuers had been enabled (reported).

events.title: UAE pilot that Mastercard called Agent Pay's first transaction outside the US
events.detail: Mastercard introduced Agent Pay in the UAE in a pilot phase with Majid Al Futtaim and the fintech Dataiera.

events.title: Latin America and Caribbean launch announced for 2026
Türkiye: Garanti BBVA demo built with reference to Agent Pay
events.detail: A demo of an AI shopping assistant, which Garanti BBVA and Mastercard called the first end-to-end agentic commerce transaction in Türkiye's banking vertical.

events.title: What Mastercard called Australia's first authenticated agentic transactions (controlled trials)
CEO: US issuers enabled for Agent Pay; global issuer base targeted for the end of the first quarter
events.detail: Prepared remarks on the fourth-quarter 2025 earnings call, known from third-party transcripts and PYMNTS; Mastercard posts no transcript, and the written earnings release does not mention Agent Pay.

events.title: Mastercard names further Asia-Pacific and EEMEA firsts (2026-02-17 to 2026-07-08)
events.detail: Among others, Mastercard named first agentic transactions or pilots in New Zealand (2026-02-17), India (2026-02), Singapore and Malaysia (2026-03-04), Hong Kong (2026-03-27), Thailand (2026-04-07), Ukraine (2026-06-23) and Moldova (2026-07-08). Several were run in controlled pilot environments; none reports volume.

events.title: Verifiable Intent CHANGELOG entry 0.1.0
Santander and Mastercard report what they call Europe's first live end-to-end agent payment (not a commercial rollout)
Stripe Shared Payment Tokens carry Mastercard agentic network tokens
Verifiable Intent announced; tag v0.1.0 on the initial commit
What Mastercard called Korea's first live authenticated agentic transaction
17 Latin American issuers and processors complete controlled live transactions
lobster.cash (Crossmint) plans Agent Pay and Verifiable Intent for OpenClaw agents
events.detail: Early access program first; every lobster.cash Agent Pay transaction is to use Verifiable Intent, with Basis Theory as the agentic credential layer. Not shown live as of 2026-11-21.

events.title: Verifiable Intent PR 23 renames fields without a version bump
Verifiable Intent contributed to the FIDO Alliance
CEO: nearly all Mastercards worldwide enabled for Agent Pay
events.detail: Prepared remarks on the first-quarter 2026 call, known from third-party transcripts and quoted by PYMNTS: a share of cards, not of issuers that are live or of purchases. In the question session he said volumes were still at an early stage. The written release mentions Agent Pay only in a CEO quote.

events.title: Mastercard says all European issuers are enabled at network level
Agent Pay for Machines announced
events.detail: The release headline says launches; its body describes AP4M in the future tense.

events.title: Verifiable Intent issue 29 on duplicate digests opened
EMVCo draft agentic framework names Verifiable Intent
Trust Framework and white paper; probability score rolling out for US testing; Skyfire as KYA partner
Agent Pay for Machines Early Access opens; Mastercard says AP4M builds on x402
events.detail: First buyer- and seller-side APIs, toolkit, sandbox and documentation for developers, after end-to-end pilots with Cloudflare, Ant International, AIsa, Base, BVNK, Coinbase and Hype. No pricing or general-availability date.

events.title: Shopify: Shop Pay agent purchases from merchants off Shopify use Mastercard tokens
events.detail: Shop Pay checkout inside personal AI agents (Muse from Meta, Claude Duet, Instinct); tokens from Mastercard, Visa and Discover for purchases from merchants off Shopify. Shopify does not name Agent Pay.

events.title: CEO: Shop Pay uses Agent Pay; OpenAI partnership includes Agent Pay
events.detail: Q3 2026 earnings call: a broad strategic partnership with OpenAI that includes the use of Agent Pay, early consumer adoption and numbers not yet significant. No written statement on the OpenAI partnership from either company was found as of 2026-11-14.

events.title: Live flight purchase with Agent Pay and Verifiable Intent (Travelport, Booked AI, Basis Theory)
events.detail: The companies say Verifiable Intent linked the customer's approval to the transaction; the release names no airline, no Verifiable Intent layer and no party that checked the chain.

events.title: Google names Mastercard for digital tokens in Gemini purchases that it says use AP2
events.detail: Google works with American Express (coming soon), Mastercard and Visa on digital tokens for supported cards; it names no Agent Pay program, Agentic Tokens or Verifiable Intent. Checkout with Google Pay in Tasks in Gemini is rolling out to US users aged 18 and over.

events.title: Temu and Mastercard memorandum: explore agentic commerce through Agent Pay
events.detail: A Temu release that quotes Mastercard's CEO; the companies will also evaluate Click to Pay. No date, market or product detail for Agent Pay.

events.title: Antom: live coffee purchase on Agent Pay with Verifiable Intent; AP4M pilot completed in Singapore
events.detail: Mastercard's release names no merchant, no market for the coffee purchase, no Verifiable Intent layer or mode and no party that checked the chain; only the AP4M pilot is placed in Singapore.

events.title: Rakuten Mobile memorandum to explore Travel eSIM with Agent Pay, with a festival demonstration
events.detail: Shown at the Singapore FinTech Festival 2026; Rakuten Mobile supplies white-label eSIM connectivity for the showcase. No launch date.

events.title: Yeahka says it signed an agreement with Mastercard; YeahPay to process Agent Pay transactions
events.detail: Per Yeahka's releases: transactions started in what Yeahka calls the Mastercard App, and a bubble tea demonstration at the Singapore FinTech Festival 2026. No launch date; Mastercard's Asia Pacific press list has no Yeahka item.
